items.title: Emile Barnes, George Guesnon, Little Brother Montgomery, Harold Dejan Interview, 1961-03-11
items.q: Yes, I'm going to blow Mr. Martin down.

ctx.x: Now my baby have gone and left me. And she must have gone out of space. Play it, Brother Curly. Because I've searched this whole wide world over. And can't find my baby. Play it.

Now that little brother Montgomery's over, Brother James, you and I going to get back together. I understand you play a violin, is that so? That's right. Yes, sir. You, you, you, you. How long have you been playing that violin? I've been playing that violin, 10 years old. Oh, man, that's a long time, man. Well, all right, then you and I go try one number on the violin and the guitar, all right? All right. That's fine. Church. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.…
